## Professional Summary

Dharmender Kumar is a Senior Backend Engineer specializing in Java, Spring Boot, microservices, and distributed systems. He has 4+ years of experience crafting scalable, enterprise-grade solutions, currently at Apollo Supply Chain. He designs and builds event-driven architectures, REST APIs, and full-stack web applications used in production environments.
